pr_title: Boards qemu cortex m0 timer rework
pr_body:
QEMU Cortex-M0 Board includes a system timer driver implementation based on the nRF TIMER peripheral, because the RTC peripheral is not supported in QEMU.

In this PR we rework the timer driver, to reflect all recent changes made to the standard nrf RTC timer driver. Various issues with the driver are fixed - including a couple of hacks to make this work with QEMU.

As a result of this rework, we can now re-enable all tests that were currently disabled for cortex-m0 QEMU, namely,
- tests/kernel/common
-  tests/kernel/tickless
- tests/kernel/timer_api (this one was never enabled)

The rework also fixes the tests/kernel/interrupt test for qemu-cortex-m0

In addition to the above, the PR removes the ENTROPY_NRF_FORCE_ALT re-definition in the Board definition and adds a 'timer' label to the timer_api suite.

Fixes #22955 (@andrewboie pls, check)
pr_comments:

The PR fixes issues on Cortex-M0 QEMU and extends ARCH coverage on the timer-related tests, so I'd hope to get this in early in the 2.4 cycle.

issue_context.title: tests/kernel/interrupt fails intermittently on qemu_cortex_m0
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug**
```
starting test - test_nested_isr
isr0 running !!
isr0 execution completed !!

    Assertion failed at ZEPHYR_BASE/tests/kernel/interrupt/src/nested_irq.c:91: isr0: (new_val not equal to old_val)
Nested interrupt is not working

FAIL - test_nested_isr
```

I am baffled as to why CI is not failing due to this.

**To Reproduce**

I'm running

```
sanitycheck -T tests/kernel/interrupt/
```

**Expected behavior**
Test passes.

**Impact**
I don't know if this is a problem with the test or the Cortex-M0 implementation.
comments: Interesting, ran locally and it passes just fine for me.  What's your build.log look like?
@galak double-checking my environment and trying the build on some other machines, will follow up shortly.
@galak if I run this test outside of sanitycheck, it fails often for me. I think this needs deeper investigation, especially since I cannot find an open bug on k_busy_wait() on qemu_cortex_m0

review_comments: optional: this function, and many others in this file, are only called once and do nothing but call another function.  Consider hoisting the call out and deleting these.
